title: Vipera: Towards systematic auditing of generative text-to-image models at scale
reasoning: The paper focuses on the design and evaluation of a visual analytics system (Vipera) to assist human auditors in identifying biases and errors in text-to-image models. While it addresses ethical concerns like social bias and misinformation, its primary contribution is in the field of human-computer interaction (HCI) and system design, rather than evaluating or benchmarking specific religious, moral, or ethical frameworks or datasets.
